## Checklist

- [ ] `go vet ./...`, `go test ./...` and `go mod tidy -diff` pass
- [ ] Tests added or updated (required for sign-in, sessions, CSRF, device signing, the relay allowlist, Wire scopes or the kill switch)
- [ ] A line under `## [Unreleased]` in CHANGELOG.md, if people will notice the change
- [ ] Nothing personal in the diff (names, emails, hostnames, local paths, secrets)
